contractScope: Current Obsidian demo archive visuals. Future mini-sites should create their own contract file.

visualItems.title: Precision Fine-Line
visualItems.serviceValue: Single-needle excellence for delicate anatomical flow.
visualItems.requiredSubject: fine-line tattoo result, controlled needle detail, or delicate skin-level linework
visualItems.assetSource: EXHIBIT_ARCHIVE image URL for Precision Fine-Line
visualItems.semanticFit: The visual must read as precise fine-line tattoo craft and support the promise of delicate anatomical flow.
visualItems.fallbackSubject: fine-line craft plate with readable skin-level linework cues
visualItems.visualProofNote: Verify the card reads as fine-line tattoo work on desktop and at 390px and 412px mobile widths.

visualItems.title: Technical Stencil
visualItems.serviceValue: Rigorous placement planning and reference-to-skin transfer.
visualItems.requiredSubject: tattoo stencil planning, transfer marks, placement blueprint, or reference-to-skin mapping
visualItems.assetSource: MaterialPlate stencil artifact with PlacementMap TECHNICAL_STENCIL overlay
visualItems.semanticFit: The deterministic stencil artifact is acceptable only because it visibly communicates planning, transfer logic, and placement preparation.
visualItems.fallbackSubject: subject-led tattoo stencil and transfer blueprint
visualItems.visualProofNote: Verify the artifact reads as stencil planning rather than abstract decoration in desktop and mobile screenshots.
